product_one_liner.value: SMS-Magic is a CRM-integrated conversational messaging platform for sales, marketing and support teams to automate and manage customer conversations across SMS, WhatsApp and other channels.

employee_band.notes: The profile reports 312 employees as of May 31, 2026.

hq_location.notes: Uses the explicitly labeled Global/U.S. Headquarters address; the careers narrative also describes Pune as the headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed indexes contain product, marketing and industry-education content, not two engineering-authored posts about building the product.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable third-party company job board lists 11 openings, none with a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title; Junior Data Engineer does not qualify. The official careers page does not expose a readable role list.

model_provider.notes: The documented FAQ Bot integration connects customer-provided OpenAI models using an API key and optional Assistant ID; this does not establish OpenAI as the default provider for every AI feature.

compliance_certs.notes: Public vendor claims: ISO 27001 certification and HIPAA/GDPR compliance; HIPAA and GDPR are compliance claims rather than independently issued certifications.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile reports no funding rounds, and the 2025 company profile describes the business as bootstrapped; no round date or amount applies.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile, updated September 22, 2026, states that the company has not raised any funding rounds.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A readable Senior Account Executive (APAC) posting and company job-board listing are available; these are third-party listings, not confirmation from a functioning official job board.

launched_6mo.notes: The September 8, 2026 company article presents the expansion from SMS-Magic to Conversive, including omnichannel conversations and Conversive Harness; this is a dated public introduction, not an explicitly stated general-availability date.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available company page lists founders rather than a complete dated executive roster. The verified COO appointment announcement is dated October 1, 2025, outside the requested window; no in-window join or departure could be established.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The subprocessor table identifies these systems, including handling client/prospect information; these are stronger internal-use signals than integrations alone.
